plugin.name: Clipboard Catgirl
plugin.description: Watches your clipboard and proactively chimes in: offer to open links, help with code, translate English, or summarize long text. Privacy-first — anything that looks like a password or key is never read, and everything stays local. Rate-limited with de-duplication, cooldown, an hourly cap, and a master switch.
panel.title: Clipboard Catgirl · Panel
panel.subtitle: Watches clipboard changes and chimes in; suspected passwords/keys are never read
panel.privacy_desc: Suspected passwords/keys/tokens are never read or stored; only a content hash is kept for de-duplication; everything is processed locally.
